_about: Round 177 (Robert, 2026-10-25): 'allow for crafting to show likelihood of positive effects and negative effects, allow for user to pick for items benefit and then the user will have a list of choices to further tailor the choices to the users wishes.' The Tailor reads the bench: pick an item and a goal, and it ranks what you could work into it, with the odds of every good and bad turn shown. Then narrow it by style, number of materials and what to avoid.
